source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps the address to children and the qualification in the Lord.
verses.before: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is right.
verses.after: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.tsw_comparator: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

verses.rationale: Preserves both parents and the narrator's explanation within the quotation.
verses.before: “Honor your father and mother”—which is the first commandment with a promise—
verses.after: “Honor your father and mother”—this is the first commandment with a promise—
verses.tsw_comparator: “Honor your father and mother”—which is the first commandment with a promise—

verses.rationale: Keeps both promised outcomes and the earth/land wording without narrowing geography.
verses.before: “so that it may go well with you and you may live long on the earth.”
verses.after: “so that things may go well for you and you may live long on the earth.”
verses.tsw_comparator: “so that it may be well with you and that you may live long in the land.”

verses.rationale: Retains the specific fathers and the contrast between provocation and nurture.
verses.before: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.after: And fathers, do not provoke your children to anger. Instead, nurture them in the Lord's discipline and instruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

verses.rationale: Names slavery plainly and retains fear, trembling, sincerity and the Christ comparison.
verses.before: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling, in sincerity of heart, as you would Christ,
verses.after: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling and with a sincere heart, as you would Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and trembling, in singleness of heart, as you would Christ;

verses.rationale: Unpacks eye-service naturally while retaining the repeated slave relationship.
verses.before: not with eye-service as people-pleasers, but as Christ’s slaves doing God’s will from the heart.
verses.after: Do not work only while someone is watching, trying to win human approval. Work as Christ's slaves, doing God's will from the heart.
verses.tsw_comparator: not by way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

verses.rationale: Keeps the contrast in the orientation of service and connects the sentence to its reason.
verses.before: Serve with goodwill as serving the Lord and not people,
verses.after: Serve with goodwill, as though serving the Lord and not people,
verses.tsw_comparator: rendering service with goodwill, as to the Lord and not to people,

verses.rationale: Retains the equal scope of recompense without making slavery metaphorical here.
verses.before: knowing that whatever good each person does, they will receive back from the Lord, whether slave or free.
verses.after: knowing that the Lord will repay each person for whatever good they do, whether slave or free.
verses.tsw_comparator: knowing that whatever good anyone does, this they will receive back from the Lord, whether slave or free.

verses.rationale: Makes the command to cease threats audible and preserves their shared Master.
verses.before: Masters, do the same things toward them, giving up threats, knowing that both their Master and yours is in heaven and that there is no partiality with him.
verses.after: And masters, treat them in the same way, and stop threatening them. You know that their Master and yours is in heaven, and he shows no favoritism.
verses.tsw_comparator: And masters, do the same to them. Stop your threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

verses.rationale: Expresses dependence on divine strength rather than self-generated resolve.
verses.before: Finally, be strengthened in the Lord and in the power of his might.
verses.after: Finally, draw your strength from the Lord and his mighty power.
verses.tsw_comparator: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

verses.rationale: Keeps armor, standing and the named adversary.
verses.before: Put on the full armor of God so that you may be able to stand against the devil’s schemes.
verses.after: Put on God's full armor so that you can stand against the devil's schemes.
verses.tsw_comparator: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil.

verses.rationale: Retains the repeated against and the nonhuman scope without identifying present-day groups.
verses.before: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood but against rulers, authorities, the cosmic powers of this darkness, and spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verses.after: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against rulers, against authorities, against the powers that rule this darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verses.tsw_comparator: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers of this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places.

verses.rationale: Preserves the evil day and the repeated standing motif.
verses.before: Therefore take up the full armor of God so that you may be able to resist in the evil day and, after accomplishing everything, to stand.
verses.after: So take up God's full armor, so that you can resist on the evil day and, having done everything, stand.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand on the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

verses.rationale: Keeps the two concrete armor images rather than replacing them with abstract advice.
verses.before: Stand, therefore, with truth fastened around your waist, wearing the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.after: Stand, then, with truth fastened around your waist and righteousness worn as a breastplate,
verses.tsw_comparator: Stand therefore, with the belt of truth fastened around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

verses.rationale: Retains readiness, footwear and the paradoxical peace message within armor imagery.
verses.before: and with your feet prepared with the readiness of the good news of peace.
verses.after: and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the good news of peace.
verses.tsw_comparator: and as shoes for your feet, the readiness given by the gospel of peace.

verses.rationale: Follows in all rather than above all and retains shield and flaming projectiles.
verses.before: In every situation take up the shield of trust, with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
verses.after: In every situation, take up the shield of faith. With it you will be able to put out all the evil one's flaming arrows.
verses.tsw_comparator: In all circumstances take up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one;

verses.rationale: Keeps receive and the source's identification of the sword with divine speech.
verses.before: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is God’s word.
verses.after: Receive the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word.
verses.tsw_comparator: and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

verses.rationale: Makes the extended prayer instruction readable and preserves all/every repetition.
verses.before: Pray at every time in the Spirit with every kind of prayer and request. To this end stay alert with all perseverance and prayer for all the holy ones,
verses.after: Pray in the Spirit at every opportunity, with every kind of prayer and petition. To that end, stay alert and persevere in prayer for all the saints.
verses.tsw_comparator: With every prayer and petition, pray at all times in the Spirit; and to that end, keep alert with all perseverance, making supplication for all the saints.

verses.rationale: Keeps dependence on given speech and the request for bold proclamation.
verses.before: and also for me, that a word may be given to me when I open my mouth to make known the mystery of the good news with boldness,
verses.after: Pray for me too, that words may be given to me when I open my mouth, so that I can boldly make known the mystery of the good news.
verses.tsw_comparator: And pray for me, that words may be given to me when I open my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,

verses.rationale: Retains the ambassador/chains contrast and repeated boldness.
verses.before: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may speak boldly in it as I ought to speak.
verses.after: It is for this good news that I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may speak about it boldly, as I ought.
verses.tsw_comparator: for which I am an ambassador in chains, that I may declare it boldly, as I ought to speak.

verses.rationale: Names the messenger and both relational and ministerial descriptions.
verses.before: So that you also may know about my circumstances and what I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything.
verses.after: So that you too may know how I am and what I am doing, Tychicus will tell you everything. He is a beloved brother and a faithful minister in the Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: So that you also may know how I am and what I am doing, Tychicus the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord will tell you everything.

verses.rationale: Keeps the plural we and the two purposes of the mission; uses an epistolary present.
verses.before: I am sending him to you for this very reason, so that you may know about us and he may encourage your hearts.
verses.after: I am sending him to you for this very purpose: to let you know how we are and to encourage your hearts.
verses.tsw_comparator: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know how we are, and that he may encourage your hearts.

verses.rationale: Includes the addressed community without altering divine titles or coupling of love and faith.
verses.before: Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with trust, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.after: Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.tsw_comparator: Peace be to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.rationale: Renders incorruptibility as enduring love while recording the broader attachment in a note.
verses.before: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with undying love.
verses.after: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
verses.tsw_comparator: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with love incorruptible.
